base_model: Each original fold's exact validation-selected frozen encoder and classifier. All parameters and buffers remain fixed in eval mode.
residual: logit_EZ_new = -logit_NEZ_original + Linear(patient_relative(channel_embedding)); equivalently new_logit_NEZ = original_logit_NEZ - residual. No new encoder, hidden layer, router or feature input.
patient_relative: Exact parent float64 within-patient population mean/SD; denominator SD if SD>1e-8 else1; cast back to float32. All valid patient channels, no label or cross-patient statistics.
initialization: Zero linear weight and bias; epoch0 included as a no-op candidate
optimizer: AdamW CPU float32, one complete patient-equal FIT batch per epoch
loss: Original FIT-only NEZ-positive weighted BCE; NEZ weight=FIT EZ count/FIT NEZ count; average within each patient then equal mean over FIT patients
selection: Exact parent validation patient Macro-F1, then EZ-F1, then earlier epoch; include epoch0. No search, no additional seed.
threshold: Parent validation-only EZ grid0:0.005:1; patient Macro-F1, EZ-F1, nearest0.5, lower threshold. Never use Outer labels.
split: Reuse exact parent five Outer folds and each parent fold's patient-disjoint FIT/validation; no fitting the adapter on original validation or any Outer patient
extraction: Frozen FP32 original forward, exact original chunks, all windows and channel aggregation. Reproduce every Original Outer patient and validation prediction. After replay parity, reuse exact hash-bound historical Outer embeddings/logits/probabilities for strict baseline identity; fresh FIT/validation representations use the same checkpoint.
outer: Freeze all20 residual states and validation-only thresholds before residual Outer prediction; seal all private scores before full Outer labels. One frozen pass, no test-driven adjustment.
metrics: Reuse parent EZ-positive metric engine; patient-macro, pooled, fold, center, coverage, all classification/probability/ranking metrics, paired patient bootstrap. No prohibited auxiliary metric.
privacy: Only code, hashes and anonymous aggregate audits/results may be public; raw, private embeddings/predictions/logits/IDs/weights/logs remain on trusted server. No permission to alter parent files.
